description: Connect the bot to a Minecraft server and wait until it spawns. Prerequisite for every other action tool. For Microsoft auth, a device-code prompt is emitted as an `msa_code` event / log notification; set `profilesFolder` to cache the token across runs.

accessToken.description: Cached MSA access token (skip device-code flow)

autoReconnect.description: Automatically reconnect on unexpected disconnect (default false)

checkTimeoutInterval.description: ms before considering the connection timed out

connectTimeoutMs.description: Max ms to wait for spawn (default 30000)

password.description: Account password (usually omit for microsoft device-code flow)

profilesFolder.description: Directory to cache Microsoft auth tokens

version.description: Force a protocol version, e.g. "1.20.4". Omit to auto-detect.

name: connect_bot
